summary.en: Late publication of the November 2 premarket brief, with information cut off at 09:00 EST. IDEXX reported Q3 revenue of $1,214M (+10% reported and organic), raising 2026 revenue guidance to $4,741M–$4,767M and EPS guidance to $14.96–$15.16. Pathfinder reported Q3 diluted EPS of $0.32, versus $0.42 in Q2 and $0.10 a year earlier.
summary.zh: 本报为11月2日盘前晨报补发，信息截至09:00 EST。IDEXX第三季度营收$1,214M（报告口径和有机口径均增长10%），全年营收指引上调至$4,741M–$4,767M、EPS指引上调至$14.96–$15.16。Pathfinder第三季度稀释EPS为$0.32，上季为$0.42、去年同期为$0.10。

title.en: IDEXX Q3 revenue $1,214M (+10%) and EPS $4.01; raises 2026 revenue guidance to $4,741M–$4,767M
title.zh: IDEXX第三季度营收$1,214M（增长10%）、EPS $4.01；全年营收指引上调至$4,741M–$4,767M

impact.en: IDEXX raised its 2026 revenue guidance midpoint by $32M and EPS guidance midpoint by $0.25, citing CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue performance. Q3 CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue grew 11% as reported and organic; over 1,900 inVue Dx placements brought the installed base to nearly 11,000 instruments.
impact.zh: IDEXX因CAG诊断经常性收入表现，上调全年营收指引中值$32M、EPS指引中值$0.25。第三季度CAG诊断经常性收入按报告及有机口径均增长11%；季度inVue Dx装机超1,900台，累计近11,000台。

bullish: 全年营收指引中值上调$32M、EPS指引中值上调$0.25 / 2026 revenue guidance midpoint raised $32M; EPS guidance midpoint raised $0.25.
第三季度CAG诊断经常性收入按报告及有机口径均增长11% / Q3 CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue grew 11% as reported and organic.

macroRisk.zh: 可用证据中未识别相关宏观风险。

title.en: Pathfinder Q3 diluted EPS $0.32 versus $0.42 in Q2 and $0.10 a year earlier; net charge-offs $4.3M
title.zh: Pathfinder第三季度稀释EPS $0.32，上季$0.42、去年同期$0.10；净核销$4.3M

impact.en: Net income was $2.1M versus $2.7M in Q2. Net charge-offs of $4.3M were fully covered by previously established specific reserves, compared with $670,000 a year earlier. Average total deposit cost declined 24 basis points year over year to 2.04%.
impact.zh: 净利润为$2.1M，上季为$2.7M。净核销$4.3M，由既有专项拨备完全覆盖；去年同期净核销为$670,000。存款平均成本同比下降24个基点至2.04%。

bullish: 存款平均成本同比下降24个基点至2.04% / Average total deposit cost declined 24 basis points year over year to 2.04%.
bearish: 稀释EPS从上季$0.42降至$0.32；净核销由去年同期$670,000增至$4.3M / Diluted EPS fell from $0.42 in Q2 to $0.32; net charge-offs rose from $670,000 a year earlier to $4.3M.
